_what: Expected answers for the named notation.times items, written from the validation row (docs/classifier/audits/rules-1C/validation.md) and the rule page (docs/classifier/rules/area-1C.md, notation.times) BEFORE the methods were compared. Label: reading. Honest note on order: tm_changes.py (the current detector's labels for all 49 items) and tm_detail.py (bar lengths and labels around each change) had been printed before this file was written; the expectations below come from the row's wording and from the bar lengths, not from the detector's labels. Classes: change = a change of metre (counted); device = partial-bar device (reported apart, not counted); cadenza = cadenza bar (reported apart, not counted). 'expected_changes_of_metre' = how many of the item's signature changes should be counted as changes of metre.

song.beautiful.mariage-damour.why: validation row: 5/4 of running sixteenths at idx 2 (and five more 5/4 bars) is a measured one-bar change, not a cadenza bar; the file's 22 signature changes are all changes of metre (no repeat/volta/words at any of them)

song.folk.scarborough-fair-piano-solo.pd.why: one 4/4 bar of quarters and eighths in 3/4 (idx 101) and the return to 3/4 (idx 102)

song.pop.misc-television-the-lonely-man-.why: one 5/4 bar of chords and eighths (idx 3) and the return to 4/4 (idx 4)

song.classical.holy-holy-holy-lord-god-o.why: the final 6/4 bar, a dotted-whole chord

song.classical.radetzky-march-for-easy-p.why: the 1/4 bar at idx 71 is, per the page, the one-bar pickup to the next section; the row says code has no test for it (no barline, repeat, key change or words in idx 60-80). A method is right here only if it leaves the bar to the agent (flag) or calls it a device; calling it a plain change is wrong

song.classical.beethoven-bagatelle-in-d-.why: three 1/4 + 1/8 pairs at repeats (idx 8-9, 26-27, 35-36) and the final 1/4 bar (idx 60) are devices; the page says they are not changes of metre. a 2/4 bar followed by a 1-beat bar at a repeat
